newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Late short-covering lifts SIMEX Nikkei at close.
newsitem.headline: Late short-covering lifts SIMEX Nikkei at close.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed at the psychologically important 21,000 points level on Friday after languishing at the lower end of a narrow range for much of the day.

"There was some quite impressive short-covering towards the end," said a trader with an Asian futures house. "But we'll need to get above resistance at 21,150/180 again before the medium-term outlook becomes good."
Market turnover was low at 14,000 lots as players showed limited interest ahead of the weekend and the release of U.S. wholesale inflation and retail sales data due at 1230 GMT.
Dealers said activity was likely to remain slow until the Japanese general election on October 20.
